prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one opaque wide 2:1 production background plate for the factual life-record handscroll in the Chinese xianxia idle game 尘缘问道. Environment and physical scroll art, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: a beautifully crafted, very wide ancient Chinese handscroll opened on a quiet dark scholar's wooden desk. The scroll is blank dark jade-green silk, not yellow parchment. It must read as a tangible large unrolled handscroll with rolled wooden ends and delicate natural cloth edges, not as a rectangular app panel.
Scene/backdrop: near-orthographic view of the desk and scroll, with only slight depth at the wooden rolled ends. Restrained old bronze fittings and subtle silk fibers. Empty dark weathered wood at the outside edges. No other objects. Refined painterly wuxia realism matching an atmospheric mountain-cave cultivation game.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape 2:1. The scroll's main body is very wide and occupies the middle horizontal band, from roughly 17 percent to 96 percent of image width and 25 percent to 75 percent of image height. Leave quiet dark wood on the left for four later DOM chapter slips. Keep the upper and lower quarters free of critical scroll details so they remain safe in a wider display. Scroll ends should be visible within the safe middle band. Its blank writing plane is almost perfectly front-facing and horizontal, without a tilted or trapezoidal text area.
Readable blank area: the central-left writing area from about 22 to 76 percent width and 30 to 70 percent height is a continuous, matte, dark jade silk field without painted lines, squares, symbols or busy ornament, ready for white game-rendered text. The right part of the scroll from about 76 to 92 percent width is also empty and calm for a later real saved-result animation. Do not paint any animation, seal or status.
Lighting/mood: soft cool ambient light, gentle material highlights only on the wooden ends and thin cloth rims; the writing surface stays evenly dark enough for pale text. Calm, intimate, archival, without dramatic glow or strong center highlights.
Color palette: ink blue, deep jade, muted pine green, weathered dark wood, very restrained antique gold edge accents. Rich surface detail without crushing it to black. No cream, bright yellow or large warm parchment areas.
Text: none.
Constraints: no people, faces, hands, books other than this one scroll, letters, brushes, ink pots, cups, coins, medicine, weapons, relics or loot. No calligraphy, characters, lines of fake writing, numbers, seals, wax stamps, logos, watermarks, UI frames, menus, tabs, labels, counters, panels or buttons. Do not depict a closed or already-sealed life outcome. One complete coherent opaque painted desk and open scroll; no transparency.
